descriptions.en:
1\. The maximum text length is 5,000 characters. The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) is 50. To request a higher limit, contact us in the DingTalk group 23369411.

2\. Before using this API, review the billing methods and pricing for the General-purpose Edition translation service.
